This Is How You Can Use A 3-Filter System To Turn Outskirt Properties Into Recession-Proof Wealth Generators

If you've been avoiding properties without MRT access or in the outskirts because agents keep telling you "location, location, location”…

This will show you the hard data proving why some of Singapore's biggest property profits came from places the market didn't believe in.

My name is Damien Tan, and I've personally invested in 3 condos using this exact strategy — properties that conventional wisdom said were "too ulu" to be profitable.

Here's what the data actually shows:

The top 5 most profitable condos in Singapore history were ALL in outskirt locations.

Not city fringe. Not near MRT. Not in prime districts.

Ulu properties that the market called risky became absolute goldmines for owners who understood the 3-Filter Selection System.

Here's what happens when you stop following market "opinions" and start following proven data:

✔️ You identify safe, profitable, and predictable opportunities in outskirt locations that outperform city fringe properties — Using our 3-filter criteria that separates actual recession-proof assets from genuinely risky ones.

✔️ You go from a "risky" portfolio to a bulletproof strategy built on Singapore's fundamentals — 85% of homeowners here have paid off mortgages, and our liquid assets exceed liabilities. This is why Singapore property is recession-proof when you know what to buy.

✔️ You see real transformation like our client who went from a $700K portfolio to $2.3M — After we repositioned his "tough to sell" property and achieved a record-breaking sale price that exceeded his expectations.

IMPORTANT: This is NOT about buying any cheap property in the outskirts and hoping it works out.

This is about using data to identify which ulu properties have the same profitable characteristics as Singapore's top 5 highest-performing condos.

If you're tired of agents pushing you toward "safe" city properties with average returns…

Click below to uncover the current ulu project we've identified using the same 3-filter system — and see exactly why outskirt condos can make more money than city fringe.
